text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our first three years in the Twinkle
Series are
over...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And Seeking the Pearl has finally made
it abroad
to run in Europe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Hello, world! ♪ What did you
think of
my running up close?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Was it not exceptional? Now...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I have no regrets! Not a single one.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following her victory, Seeking the
Pearl...
disappears.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And not a trace of her can be found in
Tracen
Academy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hello Trainer. Seeking the Pearl?
Yes, she's
still registered here at Tracen.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There's no reason she's not, as she did
not submit
any withdrawal forms to the
academy. I wonder
where she is now...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Even as student council president, I have
no idea
what she's thinking. Her gaze is
set upon such
unfathomably far sights
and goals, after all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some time has passed since Seeking the
Pearl
disappeared, but then one day...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I know where Pearl is!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Well, right now...
choice_data_list: ええっ、本当に？どこなんだ！？
ええっ、本当に？どこにいるの！？

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
She's in America! Specifically, she's in
Kentucky!
She texted me sayin' she was
at the ranch where
her dad used to be!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Learning such news sets a fire
underneath me, and
I immediately set
off for the United States.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When I arrive at said ranch, a young
Umamusume
comes to greet me.

text_block_list.name: Young American Umamusume
choice_data_list: シーキングザパールは？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I do my best to replicate Seeking the
Pearl's
signature laugh, and that seems
to make
something click. She points, and
when I look...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! That's right! I was struck with

inspiration by that lightning bolt!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I gained insight on new possibilities lying
in my
future! I nearly became a
well-done steak because
of it, but it was
a good trade-off!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Trainer? It's been forever.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Welcome! I've been waiting for you to
come get
me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There are so many things I want to ask
her, but
the thing I want to know the
most is...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: ...Sorry. I just left because I felt like it.
choice_data_list: どうして急に消えたりしたんだ？
どうして急に消えたりしたの？
choice_data_list_en: Why did you disappear all of a sudden?
Why did you disappear all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I left you and racing behind on purpose
because...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Well, because I felt like I was at a
standstill. I won
a European G1 and had
nothing left to chase.
And then...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I had a breakthrough.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl tells me about her new
dream.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Taiki and I set our sights on the world.
That was a
great era in itself, but...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't the idea of not being able to
compete
unless you go out into the
world strike you as
really old-fashioned?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Besides, you know what?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Earth is nothing but than a ball. People
should be
able to come and go as they
please.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
We shouldn't have to be the ones having
to leave
Japan and go out into the
world. We should be
the ones inviting
more Umamusume to Japan.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Then we could compete on a global
level within
Japan.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm thinking the Twinkle Series should
have an
open door policy! Imagine all
the possibilities
that would create in the
future!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It came to me right here on this ranch
while I was
standing in the pouring rain
and was almost struck
by lightning.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's put opening up Japan to
Umamusume all
over the world on our
list of things to accomplish,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl seems eager to draw
the world
into Japan with new, fresh
methods.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Heya, girlie! Come on over here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl calls out
enthusiastically to the
silent girl who
greeted me, and she walks over to
us at
the beckoning.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to bring her back with me. She
lives on
this ranch.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
She's still a diamond in the rough, so she
hasn't
managed to win her races, but she
runs well.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
She has the makings of a seeker in her.
She's
similar to me in that way, see.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: All right, then, Trainer. Let's go home!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Time to get ourselves three plane
tickets! Two
adult tickets for us, and one
child ticket for her,
to be exact!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Some time later...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Time for some Pearl family
training!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume are flocking in from all over
the
world, and it's time to battle!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Seeking the Pearl, more
Umamusume
start coming into Japan
from abroad.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Endless possibilities lay before us. Now,
the vast
world is connected as one
through the stretch of
rainbow known as
"racing."
